item.title: zBTC peg held by the Pillars' FROST key, with Bitcoin checkpoints
item.body:
zBTC issued by an embedded contract against a Bitcoin reserve that only Pillars hold the
keys to, verified by a Bitcoin light client inside go-zenon (roadmap M4b and M7).

- `btcspv`, the Bitcoin light client as an embedded contract, and `zbtc`, the peg contract
- A FROST-secp256k1 Taproot vault, Pillars only, a new key per signer set
- Withdrawal rate limit, a halt a second proof lifts, a solvency check each signer runs itself
item.author: dev-ada
